rules.message: This workflow runs a trigger.dev deploy and sets no TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN.
rules.fix: Add a per-environment token secret and map it to TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN in the deploy step's env.

bad:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env prod
        env:
          TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY }}
good:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env prod
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_PROD_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      # npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env prod (moved to deploy.yml)
      - run: npm test

rules.message: One TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN secret is used while this workflow deploys to two --env targets.
rules.fix: Store one token per environment and map each to TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN in its own job.

bad:

on:

jobs:

  production:

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env prod
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
good:

on:

jobs:

rules.message: This workflow deploys --env preview on pull_request, but pull_request.types has no closed, so preview branches are not archived when PRs close or merge.

bad:
name: preview
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env preview --external-id ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_PREVIEW_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
good:
name: preview
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed]
jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env preview --external-id ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_PREVIEW_ACCESS_TOKEN }}

rules.message: The pull_request workflow passes ${{ github.sha }} as --external-id; on pull_request that is the merge commit, not the commit the app was built from.

bad:
name: preview
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed]
jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env preview --external-id ${{ github.sha }}
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_PREVIEW_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
good:
name: preview
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed]
jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env preview --external-id ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_PREVIEW_ACCESS_TOKEN }}

rules.message: A paths: filter is set and --external-id is a commit SHA; commits outside the filter never create a deployment for that SHA, so their runs expire.
rules.fix: Derive the external id from the last commit that touched the task files, not from github.sha.

bad:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - src/trigger/tasks.ts
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env prod --external-id ${{ github.sha }}
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
good:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - src/trigger/tasks.ts
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: last-tasks-commit
        run: echo "sha=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- src/trigger)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - run: npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env prod --external-id ${{ steps.last-tasks-commit.outputs.sha }}
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN }}

rules.message: TRIGGER_VERSION is set in hosting or CI config; the SDK sends it as an explicit version, which overrides the external deployment id.
rules.fix: Remove TRIGGER_VERSION once version skew protection is verified.

rules.message: trigger.config calls syncVercelEnvVars(), a build extension that the Vercel integration docs mark as deprecated.
rules.fix: Remove the syncVercelEnvVars() entry from build.extensions.

rules.judge: Which process.env.<NAME> reads inside task code (files that define tasks) have no value in the target environment's list? Ignore reads guarded by a default or a missing-value check.
rules.message: A task reads process.env.<NAME> that is not set in the target environment.
rules.fix: Set the variable on the target environment with env set --env <target-env>, or sync it.

rules.message: trigger deploy is given --env-file; that file feeds the deploy CLI and does not set task environment variables.
rules.fix: Set task variables with env set on the target environment; keep --env-file only for values the deploy CLI needs.

bad:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env prod --env-file .env.production
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
good:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx trigger.dev@latest deploy --env prod
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
      - run: node scripts/check-env.js --env-file .env.ci

rules.message: A package.json deploy or env script runs trigger without --env, so the target environment is not explicit.
rules.fix: Add an explicit --env <name> to the script.

rules.message: A preview key is used in this workflow without TRIGGER_PREVIEW_BRANCH, so the runs have no preview branch to target.
rules.fix: Set TRIGGER_PREVIEW_BRANCH next to the preview key.

bad:
name: preview-tasks
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: node scripts/smoke.js
        env:
          TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_PREVIEW_SECRET_KEY }}
good:
name: preview-tasks
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: node scripts/smoke.js
        env:
          TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_PREVIEW_SECRET_KEY }}
          TRIGGER_PREVIEW_BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref }}

rules.message: More than one trigger.config.* exists in the repository and the GitHub integration has no config path set.
rules.fix: Set the config path in the GitHub integration settings, e.g. apps/tasks/trigger.config.ts.
rules.judge: If the repository has more than one trigger.config.* and deploys through the GitHub integration, the dashboard needs a trigger config file path set for the project. That setting is dashboard-only: ask the user to confirm it.

rules.message: A deploy step runs against a self-hosted instance (project facts say self-host) but the workflow never sets TRIGGER_API_URL, so the CLI deploys to the Cloud default.
rules.fix: Add TRIGGER_API_URL, pointing to your self-hosted webapp domain, to the deploy step's env.

bad:
name: deploy
on: { push: { branches: [main] } }
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: npx trigger deploy --env prod
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
good:
name: deploy
on: { push: { branches: [main] } }
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: npx trigger deploy --env prod
        env:
          TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
          TRIGGER_API_URL: https://jobs.internal.example.com
